proposals.intent_rationale: Visitors and expats in Vietnam hear that from 28 September 2026 foreigners can hold a VNeID account and want to know whether they qualify, where to apply, how long it takes and whether the account replaces paper documents on the road or at a rental counter.
proposals.content_angle: Built on the text of Decree 320/2026/NĐ-CP of 13 August 2026 (Government policy portal, in force 28 September 2026), the Da Nang police page (15 September 2026), the Bac Lieu police page (24 September 2026), the Dak Lak police page (28 September 2026) and KPMG Vietnam's English summary (18 September 2026). Explain the new Article 7 of Decree 69/2024/NĐ-CP: foreigners who enter or reside lawfully may be issued an account on request without a level 1 or 2 split (before, only holders of permanent or temporary residence cards), the procedure at the provincial immigration management office (passport or international travel document, Form TK01, own-name mobile number, face photo and fingerprints), the time limits of two or five working days and the foreigner's documents integrated into the app. Say clearly what is rule and what the sources do not state (for example, where an app copy of a passport is accepted at a roadside check), never claim the app replaces carrying the paper passport, and keep a boundary with the article on carrying a passport while riding.
